selected_candidates.title: Fixed-Partition Extinction Negative-Space Recovery Invariance
selected_candidates.hypothesis: When a fixed 5-zone partition (Zones 1..5, each 9 balls) experiences complete extinction (0 balls drawn) in round t, the occupancy count in round t+1 exhibits positive compensatory rebound exceeding hypergeometric expectation.
selected_candidates.opposite_hypothesis: Zone extinction has zero memory effect: next-round zone occupancy conforms strictly to the memoryless hypergeometric distribution P(k balls | 9 balls in zone, 6 drawn from 45).

selected_candidates.title: Number Proximity Minimum-Distance Repulsion Invariance
selected_candidates.hypothesis: Consecutive sorted winning numbers exhibit significant repulsion (minimum adjacent spacing > Poisson null), acting as a structural dispersion constraint.
selected_candidates.opposite_hypothesis: Adjacent ball spacing is completely memoryless and conforms strictly to the uniform order-statistics spacing null distribution.

selected_candidates.title: Pair Lifecycle Dormancy Duration Geometric Memory Invariance
selected_candidates.hypothesis: Pair lifecycle dormancy durations (gap rounds between occurrences) follow the memoryless geometric distribution, confirming complete temporal independence of ball pairings.
selected_candidates.opposite_hypothesis: Pair lifecycle dormancy exhibits non-geometric hazard aging or structural clustering.
